subject.title: feat: apply messages.responsePrefix to message tool outbound sends

question: Should visible `message(action=send)` deliveries resolve selected-attempt `{provider}`, `{model}`, `{modelFull}`, and `{thinking}` responsePrefix tokens, or should tool sends keep skipping unresolved model-selection templates by design?
rationale: Current main deliberately skips those tokens because the tool-send path does not own live model selection, while the issue discussion asks for actual current-attempt attribution on visible sends.

options.title: Resolve selected-attempt templates
options.body: Carry actual provider/model/thinking context into visible message-tool egress and test parity with direct replies.

options.title: Document the skip
options.body: Keep the current safe skip and document that model-selection responsePrefix templates are not available on message-tool sends.

recommendation.title: Resolve selected-attempt templates
recommendation.body: Carry actual provider/model/thinking context into visible message-tool egress and test parity with direct replies.

likelyOwner.reason: This is now a runtime contract/product boundary decision more than a mechanical follow-up to the partial fix.
